fields.instruction_en: Enter the full name of the child (0-18 years). RBSK provides free health screening and treatment for 4Ds — Defects at birth, Diseases, Deficiencies, and Development delays.
fields.instruction_hi: Bachche ka poora naam likhein (0-18 saal). RBSK 4 rog (4D) ke liye muft swasthya jaanch aur ilaaj deta hai — janm dosh, bimariyan, kami, aur vikas mein deri.

fields.instruction_en: Enter child's date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format. RBSK covers children from birth to 18 years through Mobile Health Teams visiting schools and Anganwadis.
fields.instruction_hi: Bachche ki janm tithi DD/MM/YYYY mein likhein. RBSK Mobile Health Teams ke zariye schools aur Anganwadion mein janam se 18 saal tak ke bachon ko cover karta hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter the parent or guardian's full name. The parent will be notified about screening results and follow-up treatment at District Early Intervention Centres (DEICs).
fields.instruction_hi: Mata-pita ya guardian ka poora naam likhein. Screening results aur District Early Intervention Centres (DEICs) mein follow-up ilaaj ke baare mein mata-pita ko suchit kiya jaayega.

fields.instruction_en: Enter the name of the school or Anganwadi centre the child attends. RBSK Mobile Health Teams screen children at these centres twice a year.
fields.instruction_hi: Bachche ke school ya Anganwadi kendra ka naam likhein. RBSK Mobile Health Teams saal mein do baar in kendroon mein bachon ki jaanch karti hain.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your district. Each district has a DEIC (District Early Intervention Centre) that provides free specialist treatment for conditions identified during RBSK screening.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna zila likhein. Har zile mein DEIC (District Early Intervention Centre) hai jo RBSK jaanch mein pehchaani gayi bimariyon ka muft specialist ilaaj deta hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter child's Aadhaar number if available. For newborns and very young children, parent's Aadhaar can be used for enrollment.
fields.instruction_hi: Agar ho to bachche ka Aadhaar number likhein. Navanjaatoon aur chote bachon ke liye enrollment mein mata-pita ka Aadhaar use kiya ja sakta hai.
